text_blocks.snippet: Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world, with a peak elevation of 8,848.86 meters (29,031.69 feet) above sea level.

list.snippet: Location: On the border between Nepal and the Tibet Autonomous Region of China, in the Himalayas.
Local Names: Known as Sagarmatha in Nepali and Chomolungma in Tibetan.
First Ascent: Reached in 1953 by Tenzing Norgay and Edmund Hillary.
Tallest from Base to Peak: Mauna Kea in Hawaii measures over 10,210 meters (33,500 feet) from its base on the ocean floor to its peak.
Farthest from Earth's Center: Mount Chimborazo in Ecuador extends the furthest due to the Earth's bulge at the equator.
